label: s1_sub_001_ecology_00
text:
Oh! Well, if isn’t my pal [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c
I’d actually love to grab your ear for something,
but...just look at how many Pokémon you’ve got!\c
Think you could make some space in your Boxes
or your team, then come talk to me again?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_02
text: Hehe... I came to check on how you’re doing!\nI AM your homeroom teacher, after all.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_03
text: Once I got here, I decided to do a bit of\nresearch on the Pokémon of Kitakami, and—[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_05
text: I got so engrossed in my own research that I\nactually forgot to come find you, didn’t I![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_06
text: Well, how about I make up for it by treating you\nto a picnic?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_07
text: I thought something like this might happen,\nso I borrowed all the usual picnic things from\r\nDirector Clavell.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_08
text: Dig in! I hope you like the sandwich I made![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_09
text: It may, um, look a bit strange—but I can assure\nyou it tastes great![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_10
text: I don’t get out much, so this kind of fieldwork\nsure wears me out quick...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_11
text: I can’t believe how you kids run all over the place\nfor your Treasure Hunt! You’re really something![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_12
text: Oh...? Could there be something in my basket?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_14
text: A Pokémon Egg appeared in the basket![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_15
text: Quite the mystery, isn’t it? I only brought Gulpin\nto this picnic with me, and yet...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_select_03
text: How could it have appeared, then?

label: s1_sub_001_select_04
text: Did you put the Egg in the basket?

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_16
text: Hehe... OK, I confess! Truth is, I had this Egg\nwith me the whole time.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_17
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hehe... I can’t get anything past you, can I,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_18
text: You know about the Pokémon Eggs you can find\nduring picnics, right?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_19
text: Whenever a Trainer doesn’t have the means to\ncare for an Egg they find, they can have it sent to\r\nthe academy, where we’ll take care of it.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_20
text: But then I thought, “Say, wouldn’t it be better to\nhave a great Trainer raise the Pokémon instead?”\r\nSo I brought this Egg with me![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_system_01
text: You were entrusted with the Pokémon Egg!

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_22
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hehe... I know it’s odd of me to come all the way
to Kitakami just to hand over a Pokémon Egg.\c
But I knew it would be safe with you,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_23
text: That reminds me—are you still using your\nPokédex app over here too?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_24
text: You should be able to fill the Kitakami Pokédex\nby catching Pokémon that live around here.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_25
text: I’ll be doing fieldwork in the area for a while...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: s1_sub_001_ecology_26
text: so let me know if you manage to complete the\nKitakami Pokédex in your app![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
